name: Monkey Rumble Re-imagined
summary: Monkey Rumble is a Fun game to play with friends, where the boundaries between monkey and machine blur in a thrilling fusion of futuristic virtual reality. In this adrenaline-fueled experience, you embody a remarkable protagonist: a cyborg monkey, stripped of its legs yet brimming with agility and power. With groundbreaking best of the best movements, traverse maps with unparalleled speed and precision.
